[[File:Fizzz.jpg|thumb|250px|A fizzz]]

The '''Dorenian Beshniquel''', also known as the '''Fizzz''', was a short, single-reed wind instrument, which was adjusted via [[peel rod]]. The instrument was commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]]. Notable Fizzz players include [[Doikk Na'ts/Legends|Doikk Na'ts]] of the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]].
